description: This file defines dispatcher classes for various network-related entities in the Playwright server, including handling of requests, responses, routes, WebSocket connections, and API request contexts. It manages communication between the core objects and protocol channels, facilitating control and introspection of network events.

classes.name: RequestDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for network requests, providing methods to access request details and response fetch.

classes.name: ResponseDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for network responses, enabling access to response properties and body.

classes.name: RouteDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for network routes, allowing control over route continuation, fulfillment, redirection, and abortion.

classes.name: WebSocketDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for WebSocket connections, handling WebSocket events and messaging.

classes.name: APIRequestContextDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing API request contexts, including fetch, storage, and disposal operations.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Factory method to get an existing dispatcher or create a new one for Request, Response, Route, WebSocket, or APIRequestContext.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Factory method to get a dispatcher or undefined if the object is null.

methods.name: rawRequestHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves raw request headers for the associated request.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Returns the response associated with a request.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Retrieves the body of a response.

methods.name: securityDetails
methods.description: Provides security details of a response.

methods.name: serverAddr
methods.description: Returns the server address info for a response.

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Returns size-related information for a response.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues a route with optional modifications.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills a route with specified response parameters.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts a route with an error code.

methods.name: redirectNavigationRequest
methods.description: Redirects a navigation request in a route.

methods.name: WebSocketDispatcher
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection lifecycle and events.

methods.name: APIRequestContextDispatcher
methods.description: Manages API request contexts for network operations, including fetch, storage, and disposal.

ctags.name: RequestDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class RequestDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Request, channels.RequestChannel, BrowserConte/

ctags.name: ResponseDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class ResponseDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Response, channels.ResponseChannel, RequestDi/

ctags.name: RouteDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class RouteDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Route, channels.RouteChannel, RequestDispatcher>/

ctags.name: WebSocketDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class WebSocketDispatcher extends Dispatcher<WebSocket, channels.WebSocketChannel, PageDi/

ctags.name: tracing
ctags.pattern: /^    const tracing = TracingDispatcher.from(parentScope as any as APIRequestContextDispatcher, re/
